# TSMP Codec RGB16 2.1.0

Stable receiver update since 2.0.0. The codec ID, sender raster, and wire layout are unchanged.

## Cumulative Changes

- Read each symbol once when assembling up to four output bytes. Handle variable bit depths, symbols smaller than one byte, and partial output groups without assuming 16 bits per block.
- Allow single-sample LUT preparation in Direct modes; Refine modes retain their own classification.
- Add optional four-tap bilinear sampling for eligible native-resolution 4x4 footprints on Core 1.1.0. It is off by default; Core 1.0.0 and other footprints use ordinary sampling.
- Refresh bundled Udon bytecode and field metadata for the receive options.
- Declare the default Luma4 header codec as a package dependency.

## Installation and Compatibility

- Recommended: Core 1.1.0 and Luma4 1.1.0, plus RGB16 2.1.0. Core 1.0.0 remains supported. Existing senders do not need a coordinated upgrade.
- VCC: use the stable packages from https://vpm.kiba.red/. VPM accepts Core >=1.0.0 and Luma4 >=1.0.0. Worlds SDK >=3.9.0 is a VPM-only dependency.
- Ordinary Unity: install Core, Luma4, and this package via a registry or explicit package sources. The UPM manifest declares 1.0.0 dependencies; select the newer packages directly in the project to use the recommended versions. VRCSDK is not required.

## Validation and Performance

- Unity 2022.3.22f1 on Windows, D3D11 / RTX 4090. With each of Core 1.0.0 and 1.1.0, the new suite passed 16 Luma4 GPU cases and 240 round trips across the three color codecs combined.
- Previous and new codecs were each tested with both Core versions. With a seeded 251-byte payload, each codec produced the same complete RGBA image across all four combinations; the GPU recovered the header and payload byte for byte.
- With Core 1.1.0 and Worlds 3.10.4-beta.2, full client-target UdonSharp compilation and SDK VM calibration, shader byte parity, fallback and cleanup tests passed. Unity resolved each compiled program inside its own package.
- No new timing claim. Radeon hardware, Quest and the live VRChat client were not tested in this release check.
